objective.title: Require meaningful frozen statement contracts and semantic review for new tasks
objective.statement: Add a backward-compatible strict task contract version covering every required declaration with exact Lean types, pinned statement-definition context, and reviewed blind mathematical read-back. Enforce it before dispatch and in independent gates. Replace mandatory reflexive theorem-name companions with compiler checked explicit contracts, preserving meaningful existing equalities and APIs. Add fail-closed regression tests, including a changed secondary deliverable and altered/missing review evidence.
deliverables: Require meaningful frozen statement contracts and semantic review for new tasks

stop_conditions: Stop at the stated file scope; report exact resisting types and preserved compiler failures if blocked.
No service operations, full builds, merges, task acceptance, or final-target claim.
